header: THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, BENCH AT SUKKUR
Allah Bachayo Katohar deceased through his L.Rs & others
Province of Sindh through Secretary Revenue Sindh & others
For applicants : Mr. Nizamuddin Noonari, Advocate
For Respondents 1 to 14 : Mr. Ghulam Abbas Kubar, Assistant
body: Adnan Iqbal Chaudhry J.– This civil revision is directed against the order dated 17.10.2022 passed by the Additional District Judge-III, Khairpur, in Civil Appeal No. Nil/2022, dismissing said appeal in limine as time-barred.

The learned appellate Court found the appeal time-barred by 12 days. Learned counsel for applicants submits that the learned appellate Court included the period of summer vacation while computing limitation, which is otherwise excluded by virtue of Section 4 of the Limitation Act, 1908. Learned counsel points out that the judgment of the trial Court was passed on 13.06.2022, certified copy was applied on 14.06.2022, the decree was prepared on 20.06.2022, copy was made ready and delivered to the applicants on 13.07.2022, and the appeal was presented on 01.08.2022, which was the first day the Court reopened after summer vacation. From the foregoing, it appears that the learned appellate Court failed to exclude the period of summer vacation as per Section 4 of the Limitation Act. If that period is excluded, the appeal was within Civil Revision No. S – 192 of 2022 Page 2 of 2 limitation, having been filed on the opening day of the summer vacation. Learned AAG Sindh also concedes that point. Therefore, the application is allowed. The impugned order dated 17.10.2022 passed in Civil Appeal No. Nil/2022 is set aside and the appeal stands restored. The civil revision application is allowed in above terms. J U D G E Abdul Basit
